ABOUT US
PROGRESS, PROTECTION, AND PEOPLE FIRST.

Assurance Total Protection helps families, drivers, and business owners move forward with coverage they understand. From everyday auto insurance to commercial protection, our role is to make the right next step clearer.

Get a Quote
See Reviews
5 States
Local support across IL, WI, IN, OH, and TX
ON THE ROAD, AT HOME, AND IN BUSINESS
Coverage that keeps up with real life.

Insurance is personal before it is paperwork. You may need protection for a family vehicle, a home, a motorcycle, a growing fleet, or a business that depends on staying in motion.

Our team helps audit coverage, explain gaps, compare options, and build policies around what you actually need protected.

Explore personal insurance
Auto, home, life, business, and specialty coverage options.
MOVING FORWARD
Simple steps. Better decisions.

Our process is built to reduce the fog around coverage, pricing, policy limits, and carrier choices.

01
Listen

We start with your vehicles, property, business, family, and financial priorities.

02
Compare

We review coverage options from quality carriers and explain where the differences matter.

03
Protect

We help you choose a policy that balances price, protection, and practical service needs.

04
Support

We stay available for policy changes, documents, payments, claims direction, and reviews.

TRUSTED AGENT
Why work with an independent agency?

One carrier can only show you one lane. As an independent agency, Assurance Total Protection can help compare multiple carrier paths for personal and commercial insurance.

For commercial clients, that means guidance for trucks, vans, fleets, liability, workers compensation, and bonds. For personal clients, it means practical support for the policies that protect home, family, and daily transportation.

PEOPLE WHO HELP YOU GROW

Trust is earned in the details: clear advice, useful follow-through, and relationships with organizations clients already know.

VALUE IN MOTION
Coverage for where you are going next.

Whether your next chapter is a new vehicle, a home purchase, a family milestone, or a business expansion, our team is here to help you protect the progress you are making.
